title: Reconstruction of compact support before applying Hom
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from D.p, and a finite extension E of Q_l. Let X be separated and finite type over Spec D.k. For the actual integral compact-support functor F defined as the constructible inclusion followed by integralDualizingCompactTower and integralDualizingLimit, every F(K) is integral constructible on Spec D.k. For every source reduction calculus S, compactification pairing system G, and base reduction calculus B, there is a natural isomorphism F followed by B.reduction with integralDualizingSystemSupport D l E X S G. No internal Hom or dualizing object occurs in this assertion.

source.place: Second proof paragraph: finite mapping-complex comparisons and reduction-compatible counits.

proof.text: Use qcqsCompactSupport_nativeTowerComparison for the fixed Nagata compactification. Uniqueness of right-derived inverse limits identifies integralDualizingLimit with coefficientConstantTowerLimit. Whiskering gives an isomorphism from F to the total limit of the native quotient support system.

Apply qcqsCompactSupport_strictReductionGamma. Its source is the actual constructible-valued integral compact-support functor, so transporting its object property gives constructibility of F(K). Its projection identity records the finite reduction isomorphisms needed for the next step.

Construct the base reduction counit at the native support system. Apply the finite scalar adjunction hom equivalence to the strict gamma projection equation and use B.counit_projection. The resulting composite of the evaluated counit with known isomorphisms is the finite reduction isomorphism. Cancellation makes each evaluated counit invertible; B.isIso_iff_evaluations makes the system counit invertible. Naturality gives the natural system isomorphism.

Identify the ordinary open and proper operations of G with the native quotient-module operations. Derive the ordinary natural isomorphisms and whisker with the source reduction. Compose this comparison with the reconstructed native support system. No Hom or duality operation enters.

lean.statement:
theorem integralDualizing_support_reduction
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (G : CoefPairingSystem l E (finiteDualizingCompactification D X) S)
    (B : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E (Spec (.of D.k))) :
    let F := (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙
      integralDualizingCompactTower l E D hl X ⋙
        integralDualizingLimit l E (Spec (.of D.k))
    (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      sfIntegralConstructible l E (Spec (.of D.k)) (F.obj K)) ∧
      Nonempty (F ⋙ B.reduction ≅ integralDualizingSystemSupport D l E X S G)
